authority_boundary: This policy approves the classification and rendering architecture. It does not authorize an unrecorded person assignment, public naming decision, anonymisation, withdrawal or private-source publication.

neutral_identity_layer.rule: The immutable identity registry resolves identity only. It is not public-list or perimeter authority.

public_list_order.label_es: Partes privadas adversas e intereses opuestos documentados
public_list_order.label_en: Adverse private parties and documented opposing interests

OUR_CORE.scope: Claimant, director, declarant, rights-holder or person directly asserting or defending project-side rights.

OUR_REPRESENTED_INTEREST.scope: Entity or interest whose assets, income, control, rights or claimant-specific losses are being protected or recovered.

ADVERSE_FORMAL_PARTY.scope: Private formal opposing party, creditor, purchaser, claimant, owner or governance interest for the stated matter and period.

ADVERSE_PRIVATE_FUNCTIONAL_ACTOR.scope: Private person with a source-supported, dated alleged or documented adverse act concerning governance, control, possession, voting, access, assets, income or implementation.

OUR_CURRENT_PROFESSIONAL.scope: Current professional acting for a project-side client or interest.

OUR_FORMER_PROFESSIONAL.scope: Former professional acting for a project-side client or interest.

ADVERSE_PARTY_PROFESSIONAL.scope: Professional representing or advising an adverse party; representation alone does not make the professional an adverse private actor.

INSTITUTIONAL_OFFICEHOLDER.scope: Judge, judicial officer, fiscal, police, regulator, authority or court-appointed officeholder track.

WITNESS_EXPERT_CUSTODIAN.scope: Person principally relevant as witness, expert, technical professional, contemporaneous recipient or document custodian.

TRANSACTION_DEVELOPMENT_PRIVATE.scope: Prospective investor, buyer, lender, banker, operator, introducer or ordinary commercial counterparty; private by default.

UNRESOLVED_PRIVATE_CANDIDATE.scope: Identity, capacity or legal relevance unresolved; no public person-level display.

prohibited_inferences: Perimeter membership is not guilt or liability.
A relationship does not transfer knowledge, intent, control or responsibility.
A lawyer is not an adverse private actor merely because of the client represented.
A professional for our side is not part of our ownership or claimant perimeter merely because of the mandate.
A judge, fiscal or insolvency officeholder is not a private adverse party merely because an act or omission is challenged.
A witness, expert or custodian is not adverse merely because the evidence may contradict the project.
Transaction interest, meeting attendance or chronology does not establish either principal perimeter.

current_specific_controls.reason: Historic banking or transaction-development contact alone is insufficient for either principal legal perimeter.
